name: Kobayakawa Tenchi
source:
Pacific Ocean Super Power Instruction Institution 1st year student.
His older brother was the former captain of the Akizuki High's Superpower Club.
He contacts Azuma and the team while investigating the incident surrounding his brother.
He has the same superpower as Azuma "Super Vibration", however he specializes in using it to lower the temperature of objects.
